bundle.shortDescription: Native macOS portfolio tracker for Ethereum & NFTs
bundle.longDescription: Westron is a native macOS application for Ethereum investors and NFT traders. Portfolio tracking, NFT gallery, bulk trading, analytics/PnL, real-time alerts, and sniping — all with keys stored locally in macOS Keychain.
